caption: Independent FEM opposing-load curves retain the raw global four-corner von Mises maximum. CAD remeshing changes volume and boundary approximation together. Frozen seed-polyhedron controls retain volume, boundary area and centre of mass while uniformly refining tetrahedra. The second figure compares full unsmoothed tensors at unchanged physical interior probes; points outside either adjacent approximate domain remain explicitly listed in the source data. The3% dotted line is an initial engineering diagnostic, not continuum-error certification. Energy, displacement and other loads are retained in the complete CSV/JSON. No smoothed maximum or asymptotic extrapolation is used.
body_interpretation: The frozen-U raw peak grows on seed reentrant creases while remeshed-U peaks decrease toward the latest range. Small common-tensor changes coexist with nonmonotone raw peaks on several shapes. A complete operating range requires the full observable set and resolved-contact comparisons.
open_issues: Joint CAD/volume changes are not separated for every shape; native finer accuracy/cost and coupled egg/contact acceptance remain required
